author: DiscussingFilm
text:
The FCC has approved foreign investors from the Middle East to own 49.5% in the merged WB/Paramount company.

• The investors will not own voting stock so reportedly will have no influence on company decisions

• Approval also has been given to permit up to 100% indirect foreign equity interest in Paramount
